name: Akapulu Labs
description: Akapulu Labs is an AI research lab building live conversational avatars.

instructions: Akapulu Labs builds live AI avatars on real-time calls. Two paths: (1) your Pipecat voice bot plus Akapulu Labs avatar video on top, or (2) a hosted link when you want a call without writing a bot. Calls use conversation minutes (akapulu.com/pricing).

Recommended path: build voice in Pipecat, then add the public pip package pipecat-akapulu (uv add / pip install). Its AkapuluAvatar processor sits after assistant audio and sends that speech to Akapulu Labs. The browser, your bot, and the avatar meet in a Daily room you create and own. Your bot listens and does not publish camera/mic; the Akapulu Labs worker publishes the face and played audio. POST /api/live-sessions/ with avatar_id, show_ai_label, room_url, and avatar_token; response is session_id. Keep AKAPULU_API_KEY on the server.

Hosted link: a public page Akapulu Labs hosts. Set avatar (which face), system prompt (what the conversation is for), and This is AI (label on the video). Create in the dashboard or with Bearer CRUD on /api/hosted-links/ (GET/POST collection; GET/PUT/DELETE by id; DELETE collection with {"ids":[...]}). Response includes url and token. Open the URL, click Start Call. No bot to run; page never sees the API key.

Loading status is a server message with type status. Do not poll for it. Every avatar frame has an invisible mark; verify an mp4 with POST /api/video-marks/ and POST /api/video-marks/<id>/read/. API errors include error_code — branch on that field, not the English string.
